summary:
BOTH FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING END-TO-END. (1) BackgroundAurora — DOM inspection at 375x667 shows the bg-hero img is now rendered at exactly viewport size (w=375, h=667, x=0, y=0) on Home, Shop, Cart, Profile AND /product/[id]. Screenshots confirm the whole pepper/basil/olive/chili composition is visible centered on every screen. useWindowDimensions() + explicit width/height on both container View and RN Image resolved the intrinsic-1600x2000 overflow reported in iteration_9. (2) withFocusGate HOC — tab bleed-through is fully eliminated. On Cart tab, 'Farm-fresh, cut on demand'=0, 'Shop by category'=0, 'Deliver to Bengaluru'=0, 'My Basket'=1. On Profile tab, 'Farm-fresh'=0, 'Shop by category'=0, 'My Basket'=0, 'Profile' label appears (2 hits = 1 header + 1 tab-bar label, expected). On Shop tab, 'Farm-fresh'=0, cat-chip-all present, aurora visible. On Home tab, 'Deliver to Bengaluru'=1, 'Farm-fresh'=1 (only own content).

Product detail /product/[id] opens without hooks error, bg-hero present at 375x667, no red-screen indicators, no 'Rendered fewer hooks' string. Backend green: GET /api/products = 164, GET /api/products?category=organic = 0 (as expected, no seed).

Regression checklist:
[OK] Home shows FULL pepper/basil/olive/chili image centered on screen (screenshot verified)
[OK] 'Deliver to Bengaluru' appears exactly once on Home, zero on other tabs
[OK] 'Farm-fresh, cut on demand' appears once on Home, zero on Shop/Cart/Profile
[OK] Cart tab clean — 'My Basket' visible, no Home elements bleed through
[OK] Shop tab clean — category chips visible, no Home bleed
[OK] Profile tab clean — profile UI, no Home elements
[OK] Background image visible on all 4 tabs + product detail (viewport sized 375x667)
[OK] Tapping product card opens /product/[id] cleanly, bg still visible
[OK] Backend GET /api/products = 164
[OK] Backend category=organic = 0 (no products seeded)

Minor non-blocking console noise: react-native-web deprecation warnings for shadow* and props.pointerEvents (cosmetic); one React DOM warning about `defaultMuted` prop on <video> (from HeroVideo web branch, pre-existing, not related to this iteration).
action_items: No action items — both requested fixes verified. If main agent wants to polish: (a) address the pre-existing `defaultMuted` DOM warning in app/(tabs)/index.tsx HeroVideo web branch by using `defaultMuted={true}` inline rather than as a string DOM attribute; (b) consider dropping the white veil rgba(255,255,255,0.22) in BackgroundAurora.tsx line 38 to something like 0.10 so the produce composition is more vivid (optional aesthetic tuning).
critical_code_review_comments: BackgroundAurora.tsx now correctly uses useWindowDimensions() and applies width/height to both the outer View and RN Image, so the image is bounded to viewport. Clean, minimal implementation.

withFocusGate.tsx is a small, idiomatic HOC using useIsFocused() from @react-navigation/native. Correctly returns null for inactive scenes, letting the shared aurora paint through. Applied consistently to all four tab default exports (index.tsx L303, shop.tsx L150, cart.tsx L153, profile.tsx L80).

Tabs layout keeps `detachInactiveScreens`, `freezeOnBlur`, `lazy`, `unmountOnBlur` — all four together plus withFocusGate is belt-and-suspenders; safe but note `unmountOnBlur` on Tabs.Screen options is technically a bottom-tab specific listener option and may log a warning in newer react-navigation versions. Not observed in this run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both fixes verified across all 4 tabs + product detail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_10 fully validates the iter_9 recommendations. Aurora is now viewport-bounded (verified via getBoundingClientRect w=375 h=667 on 375x667 viewport across Home/Shop/Cart/Profile/product-detail). Bleed-through eliminated via withFocusGate — Home-only strings ('Farm-fresh, cut on demand', 'Shop by category') return count=0 when on any non-Home tab. Backend catalog stable at 164 products; organic category intentionally empty. Nothing to retest.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both bugs from iteration_9 are resolved. Root causes were correctly identified in iter_9: (1) RN Image on web derived intrinsic 1600x2000 sizing when parent was flex-only; fixed by explicit width/height via useWindowDimensions on both View and Image. (2) freezeOnBlur/detachInactiveScreens alone did not hide painted DOM under a transparent scene theme; fixed by short-circuiting render in each tab default export via useIsFocused()==false → return null.
